mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabled, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disabled FROM candidates WHERE agency_id = #{agencyId}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_applications WHERE agency_id = #{agencyId} GROUP BY status

SELECT COUNT(jd.id) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN jd.status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_jobs, SUM(CASE WHEN jd.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_jobs FROM job_agency_assignments ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id WHERE ja.agency_id = #{agencyId} AND ja.is_enabled = true AND jd.is_active = true

SELECT ja.id, jd.title as job_title, CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) as candidate_name, ja.status, ja.applied_at FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id INNER JOIN candidates c ON ja.candidate_id = c.id WHERE ja.agency_id = #{agencyId} ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) as full_name, trade, is_enabled, created_at FROM candidates WHERE agency_id = #{agencyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT jd.id, jd.title, c.name as country, jd.total_slots, jd.remaining_slots, jd.status, jd.created_at FROM job_agency_assignments ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id LEFT JOIN countries c ON jd.country_id = c.id WHERE ja.agency_id = #{agencyId} AND ja.is_enabled = true AND jd.is_active = true ORDER BY jd.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE(applied_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_applications WHERE agency_id = #{agencyId} AND applied_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(applied_at) ORDER BY date DESC

SELECT DATE(updated_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_applications WHERE agency_id = #{agencyId} AND status = 'SHORTLISTED' AND updated_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(updated_at) ORDER BY date DESC
